subject: Sproutly inbound: credit eligibility check for evaluation
messages:
From: trial-intake@intercom.io
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-11T09:03:00Z
Subject: New inbound credit request (Sproutly)

New inbound PLG form submission from Sproutly (samira@sproutly.ai)

Message:
Hi Redwood team —

We're evaluating Redwood for a small prototype to power our support summarization + semantic search. We're a seed-stage startup (8 people) and would love to try the playground and a small evaluation workload. Can you share eligibility for credits and any constraints? Ideally we'd like ~$400 in credits to run 100k tokens of evaluation over the next 2 weeks.

Company: Sproutly
Contact: Samira Khan, Head of ML (samira@sproutly.ai)
Use case: support summarization, embeddings for KB
Monthly expected token usage if we move to prod: ~5M tokens
Notes: We use GA4 telemetry and do not plan to send PII. Interested in self-serve credits or quick approval.

-- Intercom (inbound form)

From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
To: samira@sproutly.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-11T10:12:00Z
Subject: Re: New inbound credit request (Sproutly)

Hi Samira —

Thanks for the submission and welcome! I'm Hannah on the PLG intake team. Quick clarifying questions so we can route this correctly:

- Is the 100k tokens estimate for playground runs or API calls (chat/generate vs embeddings)?
- Are you signing up with a corporate email (samira@sproutly.ai) or personal? (helps for fraud checks)
- Any compliance / contract needs during the eval (SOC2 evidence, data residency) or is this purely self-serve?

If this is playground/embeddings evaluation and no PII, we can usually approve a sandbox credit grant within 24 hours. I'll loop Ben for dollar approvals if we need to go above the standard test amount.

Next steps from us:
- Please reply with the answers above and attach a short one-pager on the expected workload (if possible).
- If approved, we'll provision credits to your account and share instructions for token budgeting and prompts to reduce cost.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Growth Programs | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
--
Redwood Inference — production-first inference for developers

From: Samira Khan <samira@sproutly.ai>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-11T10:37:00Z
Subject: Re: New inbound credit request (Sproutly)

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for the quick reply. Answers below:

- The 100k tokens are mostly API embedding calls for our internal KB and occasional generation for summarization (~70% embeddings, 30% short generations).
- Yes, corporate email (samira@sproutly.ai).
- No SOC2 or residency needs for this evaluation; we'll keep data synthetic where helpful.

I've attached a short one-pager (sproutly_use_case_summary.pdf) with approximate volumes and timelines. If it's helpful: our CTO is Maya Patel (maya@sproutly.ai) and may join a short call.

Rough ask: a $400 credit to run these tests this month so we can make a decision. If you need a quick call, happy to do 15 min.

Best,
Samira
Head of ML, Sproutly
